text.p: Dhaka stocks edged up by more than one percent as investors returned, ending a brief downward correction, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index rose 37.82 points or 1.16 percent at 3,272.90. Turnover was 570.9 million taka. Of the 111 issues traded, 60 gained, 49 lost and two ended flat.

"The market was very active today. Profit taking continued on some issues. But buyers were again the dominant group," said a broker. Beximco Pharma gained 21.94 taka to 464.34 and Amam Sea Food lost 832.50 to 15,817.50.
